summary.oneLiner: Hathway Bhawani Cabletel & Datacom Limited is a Mumbai-based cable television (CATV) services provider and a subsidiary of Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited.
summary.business: The Company provides Cable Television (CATV) services, focusing on delivering seamless viewing to subscribers and engaging with customers to understand their entertainment preferences and offer customised packages aligned with their requirements. It operates as a subsidiary of Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited (HCDL) and, following the acquisition during the year of the remaining 49% stake in Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited, holds that entity as a wholly owned subsidiary. Management notes that the CATV industry is in a downturn but expects its customer-centric approach to support growth …

endMarkets: Retail cable television subscribers, India (registered office and operations based in Mumbai)

risks.note: The Board's Report explicitly states that 'the downturn in the CATV industry has presented certain challenges' to the Company. As a pure cable-television service provider, the Company's subscriber base and revenue are directly exposed to the structural decline of the CATV industry; management's only stated mitigant is a customer-centric approach with customised packages intended to strengthen customer confidence and support subscriber growth in coming years.

risks.risk: Revenue contraction and a swing to a loss at both standalone and consolidated level
risks.note: The Board's Report narrative records that revenue from operations was lower than the prior year on both a standalone and consolidated basis and that the Company reported a loss after tax against a profit in the prior year, with retained earnings remaining in deficit. On a very small revenue base this leaves little cushion, and the Board recommended no dividend and transferred no amount to reserves for the year under review.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Part of the Hathway group — Hathway Cable and Datacom Limited is the holding company, and the Company adopts HCDL's group-wide risk management framework
- Customer-centric service approach with customised packages aimed at strengthening customer confidence and the subscriber base

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Board's Report explicitly states that 'the downturn in the CATV industry has presented certain challenges' to the Company. As a pure cable-television service provider, the Company's subscriber base and revenue are directly exposed to the structural decline of the CATV industry; management's only stated mitigant is a customer-centric approach with customised packages intended to strengthen customer confidence and support subscriber growth in coming years.
- The Board's Report narrative records that revenue from operations was lower than the prior year on both a standalone and consolidated basis and that the Company reported a loss after tax against a profit in the prior year, with retained earnings remaining in deficit. On a very small revenue base this leaves little cushion, and the Board recommended no dividend and transferred no amount to reserves for the year under review.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhance customer experience through the introduction of various offerings and initiatives aimed at delivering seamless Cable Television (CATV) services
- Strengthen customer service standards and actively engage with customers to understand their entertainment preferences and offer customised packages aligned with their requirements
- Consolidate ownership of the subsidiary — the Company acquired the remaining 49% stake in Hathway Bhawani NDS Network Limited during the year, making it a wholly owned subsidiary
